reproduction_unchanged: Original state-specific random-split reproduction follows the separately adjudicated paper/code recipe.
improvement_reference: Explicit pooled-state adaptations of regularized full-covariance and diagonal LDA.
class_prior_policy: Uniform six-class priors for both matched LDA references; no silent empirical-prior default under imbalanced calibration.
inner_objective: Balanced six-class accuracy on predeclared stratified five-fold splits wholly inside calibration; the fixed split manifest, search policy and search budget must be frozen before exposure.
covariance: Full reference selects gamma/delta through fixed calibration-only policy; diagonal reference fixes gamma=1 and selects delta. Same neural features and permissions as candidate.
outer_selection: Other four animals select/freeze candidate algorithm and tuning policy. Held calibration can fit parameters under that frozen policy. No held-evaluation feedback.
state_access: No state labels or privileged state-based model dispatch for any system; owner stratifies output scoring only.
status: Required recipe policy; no LDA fitter or original-runtime calibration has been implemented/executed.
resource_limit: Numeric runtime/search/fit limits remain owner admission gates; never infer them from process counts.
